email.body1:
Samantha, saw QuotaPath just launched Atlas, your AI Revenue Strategist tying comp plans to GTM motion.

A launch like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can work before reps are stretched thin, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for QuotaPath off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Samantha, quick follow-up for QuotaPath.

Riding a product launch, demand often outpaces what the team can cover, and most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit target this quarter. So the gap shows up late, and recovering the number turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings QuotaPath needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Samantha, last bit of proof for QuotaPath.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how QuotaPath's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Samantha, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while Atlas takes off, no problem at all. Timing is everything around a launch, and I know that stretch keeps a sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to QuotaPath either way.
